pain_paragraph: Monthly investor updates and board prep usually happen late at night because the numbers live in different tools, the narrative is fuzzy, and no one actually owns the final assembly. That means delayed updates, inconsistent reporting, and stressful board meetings that feel harder than they should.

pricing_details: Starter includes one monthly investor update or lightweight board pack for one company, one reporting template, and one revision cycle. More stakeholder complexity or custom analytics can be scoped separately.
guarantee_line: If we miss the agreed monthly delivery window, we credit 25% of that month’s fee.

faq.q: How do you access our metrics and board materials safely?
faq.a: Least-privilege access only: shared folders, exports, or view-only dashboards where possible. No production credentials required. Optional NDA and clear access revocation at any time.

faq.q: What do you need from us before you can start?
faq.a: A named owner, your current reporting template if one exists, and access to the few systems that hold the numbers or notes you already use. We work best when the source data is already available somewhere, even if it is messy.
Usually 60-90 minutes total across one kickoff and one async follow-up. After that, the monthly cycle should feel lightweight.

faq.q: Do you keep our materials forever?
faq.a: No. We keep only what is needed for active work and agreed archive history. Retention windows can be set up front, and we can delete materials on request.

faq.q: Are you replacing our CFO, finance lead, or chief of staff?
faq.a: No. We run the reporting assembly workflow and first-pass drafting. Final numbers, judgment calls, and investor communication stay with your team.

trust_basics_line: Not financial, fundraising, or legal advice. You remain the source of truth for company performance and investor communications.
